item1.q: How do I join the server?
item1.a: Click “Join the server” on the homepage, sign in with your Microsoft account and complete the application form.

item2.q: Do I need a genuine copy of Minecraft?
item2.a: Yes. Your identity is verified through Microsoft's official authentication, so a genuine account is required.

item3.q: Which version does the server support?

item4.a: Stay active in the community — we invite dedicated players to join the team.

item5.q: I need help. Where do I go?
item5.a: Join our Discord and open a ticket. The team is happy to help.

behavior.title: General conduct

gameplay.title: Game rules
gameplay.content: No cheating, hacking or exploiting. Play fairly and respect the spirit of the game.

building.title: Building rules

economy.title: Economy rules

punishment.title: Penalties

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Just create an account to take part. Linking Microsoft is an optional bonus.
auth.privacy: We never see or store your Microsoft password. Authentication is handled entirely by Microsoft.
auth.why1: Publish resources, comment, like and download
auth.why2: Enter your Minecraft ID in the dashboard — your avatar updates right away
auth.why3: Link Microsoft to earn an avatar frame

New applications must be added to Mojang's API allow list before sign-in can work. The approval request has been filed and is reviewed weekly — this is not an issue with your account. If it persists, contact enforce@minecraft.net.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Closing your account cannot be undone.
dangerZone.hint: Moving on? Closing your account signs you out immediately.
dangerZone.consequence1: The account stops working at once — you cannot sign in, and the email cannot be reused
dangerZone.consequence2: Username, email, password, Microsoft link and Minecraft ID are all erased
dangerZone.consequence3: Resources and comments you posted are **kept**, shown as “Deleted user”
